metaDescription: Free Fortnite tracker and stats checker: look up any Epic username for K/D, wins, win rate, matches, kills, Solo/Duo/Squad breakdowns, and Battle Pass level.
hero: Free Fortnite stats checker — look up any player by Epic username (or PSN / Xbox). See K/D, wins, win rate, matches, kills, Solo / Duo / Squad / LTM splits, input-device breakdowns, and Battle Pass level when available.

trackerTitle: Free Fortnite stats tracker & username lookup
trackerBody: People search “Fortnite stats”, “Fortnite tracker”, and “Fortnite K/D check” every day. This tool resolves a display name through Fortnite-API and shows the full Battle Royale career (or current season) snapshot Epic exposes — overall plus playlist and input splits — so you can compare teammates, check a lobby name, or track your own progress.
step1: Type the exact in-game name (watch for zeros vs O, and creator suffixes).
step2: Pick Epic, PlayStation, or Xbox if the name lives on that platform identity.
step3: Choose Lifetime or Current season, then Look up.
step4: Share the URL — it keeps the player name in the query string after a successful search.
showTitle: Stats we show when Epic provides them
headlineBody: K/D ratio, wins, win rate, matches, kills, deaths, kills per match, score, and minutes played.
modeBody: Solo, Duo, Squad, and LTM rows (Trio is often empty in the API). Placement tops (Top 3 / 5 / 10 / 25) when present.
inputBody: All inputs, plus Keyboard & Mouse, Controller, and Touch when the account has played on those devices.
bpBody: Season Battle Pass level and progress toward the next level when the API returns it.

faqs.q1: How do I look up Fortnite stats by username?
faqs.a1: Enter an Epic display name (or PSN / Xbox gamertag with the matching platform selected), choose Lifetime or Season, then search. We load Battle Royale wins, K/D, matches, win rate, kills, and mode breakdowns from Fortnite-API.
faqs.q2: Why are some Fortnite stats missing or private?
faqs.a2: Players can hide stats in Epic account privacy settings. Platform name mismatches (Epic vs PSN vs Xbox) also return “not found.” Try the other account type or exact in-game spelling.
faqs.q3: What Fortnite stats can I see?
faqs.a3: Overall and per-mode (Solo, Duo, Squad, LTM) stats including wins, K/D, kills, deaths, matches, win rate, score, minutes played, players outlived, and placement tops when Epic provides them — plus Battle Pass level when available.
faqs.q4: Is this an official Epic Games stats tracker?
faqs.a4: No. FortniteTools is an independent fan site. Stats come from a third-party Fortnite data API and can lag or change when Epic updates their systems.
